items.text: Table A shows the units for rate constants,using mol dm-3 as the unit of concentration and seconds as the unit of time. You find the units by rearranging the rate equation.

| Zero    | mol dm-3 s-1  |
| First   | s-1           |
| Second  | dm² mol-1 s-1 |
